content.short: Dualism® is a multiverse with countless entertainment possibilities that is not limited to a TCG (Trading Card Games) style card game.
content.description:
Dualism® is an extremely exciting game universe where players will be able to trade, collect items, create battle strategies, play with other users and advance in rank seeking the best rewards. Each player is an avatar, and in addition to participating in TCG (Trading Card Game) style card games, they will be able to explore the world of Dualism®, carry out quests, acquire portions of lands (Lands) and receive monetary rewards for doing so. Dualism® will have a player-owned economy, where players will be able to own, buy, sell and trade the resources they earn in the game through skilled gameplay and contributions to the ecosystem.

The gaming community will have the option to rent decks, acquire battlegrounds, and have a say in the expansion of the ecosystem. Aiming at a sustainable economy, all the value collected in the game will be converted into rewards for the players themselves, moving towards the total decentralization of the game. With quality entertainment and a practice contrary to the market, Dualism® brings a sustainable economic model where fundraising will not be limited to the sale of NFTs.

Dualism® brings a proposal for valuing and developing professionals. Our careers platform will capture and export professionals who participate directly in the project. Also, Dualism will serve as a showcase for the job market by exporting all professionals trained through vocational courses available on the platform.

We want to give opportunities to low-income young people who want to become professional and seek a space in the job market. Initially, we will have professional courses for programmers (focus on blockchain), illustrators and producers.
